source.snippet: Show HN: Guitoro, a virtual guitar you strum with your keyboard. Comment: 'I would pay for this in a VST form'

problem_statement: Musicians and music producers lack an affordable, keyboard-driven virtual guitar VST instrument that feels natural to play without a physical guitar, creating a gap between hobbyist web demos and professional DAW-ready plugins.
target_segment: Music producers, bedroom beatmakers, and composers who use DAWs (Ableton, Logic, FL Studio) but do not play guitar
notes: Explicit willingness-to-pay: commenter stated 'I would pay for this in a VST form.' VST plugin market has established paid distribution channels (e.g., Plugin Boutique). Solo signal but direct buyer intent expressed.
